desc: Blocking pipeline waits within a budget per frame (Aurora 0070; a community report's slow CPU held a new room's frame for seconds and Windows whitened the window): a 1 ms budget (AURORA_BLOCKING_BUDGET_MS, tests otherwise wait without one) is spent on the first new pipelines, the rest build in the background, and the field still plays. Its own empty pipeline cache ({out}/cache): on the runner's shared one, warm from earlier scenarios, no new pipeline is waited on
log_must: Blocking pipeline waits over 1 ms this frame: the rest built in the background
